prompts: Create a new first-person defensive blocking sprite for the giant gauntlets from the supplied game-art reference. Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image 1 defines the exact dark weathered bronze/iron gauntlet design, engraved orange runes, heavy rings, material palette, low-resolution painted sprite aesthetic. Change the pose: the player raises BOTH armored forearms vertically immediately in front of their face like a boxer doing a tight high guard; the elbows are pressed together at the bottom center and the little-finger edges of both clenched fists meet near the top center. First-person from the wearer's eyes, looking at inside/side edges of one's own fists and forearms; never third-person front-facing knuckles. Two fists, two forearms, compact symmetrical protective wall; hands at top, touching elbows at bottom, tapered inward bottom. No weapon, shield, person, face, torso, background, or text. Match the restrained desaturated worn-metal colors of the reference with small dim orange rune accents, no bright glow. Transparent background, alpha cutout. Landscape 3:2 canvas, complete paired arms centered, extend forearms into bottom edge, occupy central half of canvas width and nearly its full height. Preserve the original gauntlet identity and thick armored construction. Native game HUD asset, no environment or cast shadow.

Edit image 1 (the paired first-person boxer blocking guard) ONLY to match the tier-2 materials/colors of image 2 (existing tier-2 game gauntlets). Preserve exactly the compact raised two-fist guard, silhouette, perspective, proportions, position, transparent background, canvas dimensions, and all armor construction from image 1. Replace bronze armor coloration with the worn dark silver/iron bands and dull dark red inset plates seen in image 2; runes are dim bone-white like image 2, not orange. Restrained muted colors matching original sprites, no brighter polished metal. Elbows together at bottom, fists side by side at top. Only two arms, no other body parts. Keep alpha transparency; no background, text, framing or effects. Native dark-fantasy first-person game sprite.

Edit image 1 (paired first-person boxer blocking guard) ONLY to match the tier-3 materials/colors of image 2 (existing tier-3 game gauntlets). Preserve exactly the compact raised two-fist guard, silhouette, perspective, proportions, position, transparent background, canvas dimensions, and all armor construction from image 1. Match image 2's charcoal iron plates, restrained weathered brass/gold bands, and dim pale blue-white engraved runes. No orange or red runes. Muted, worn-metal palette matching the supplied low-resolution dark-fantasy game sprite, no additional glow. Elbows together at bottom, fists touching side by side at top. Only two arms, no other body parts. Keep actual alpha transparency; no background, text, framing or effects.
